correctness.rationale: The proof separates the coordinate calculation from the lattice comparison. Smoothness of the source quartic forces nonzero edge discriminants, giving four fixed points on each source coordinate line and two quotient points on each quotient edge. The primary source independently supplies the abstract twenty-four fixed points and quotient lattice. The local equation at every edge point is reduced to \(uv+w^2=0\), which proves the \(A_1\) type and the two local ruling curves. The hyperplane pullback relations then determine the incidence and lattice index. Exact arithmetic in `verify.py` reproduces rank \(13\) and discriminant \(2^8\), matching the source classification for the very general quotient.
